principle: ARIS owns the method and artifact contract. Pi multi-agent owns execution: each stage is run by a narrow role that loads only that stage's skills. The research loop owns only goal, ledger and stuck detection.

scaling.note: Start with what fits; add more as memory frees up. Each explorer must cover a distinct angle, not a duplicate.

sequentialRole.purpose: independent novelty and falsifiability check before the stage gate

1-idea.isolation: Every explorer works in its own directory and must not read another explorer's output; the main agent merges only after they return.
1-idea.gate: loop: every candidate needs a falsification condition and at least one source; no majority vote.
explorerAngles: prior-art collision (what would make this incremental)
scale and regime transfer (does it hold at another limit)
1-idea.scalingNote: Explorer count is memory-gated, not fixed. Query research-loop/scripts/explorer-capacity.mjs before each launch; start a subset and add the rest when MemAvailable permits.

roles.note: one scheduler node, submission needs explicit approval

2-experiment.isolation: Each run writes its own directory; raw outputs are never overwritten.
2-experiment.gate: real command, exit code, seeds and input hash must be recorded; a model summary is not execution proof.

roles.modelPolicy: must differ from the author's model family

replacement.local: research-critic spawned by native subagent, with REVIEWER_MEMORY.md carrying round-to-round state
replacement.why: Codex MCP is not registered in this Pi; an ephemeral one-shot loses thread continuity, which ARIS explicitly rejects
replacement.acceptance: review-gate checks observed reviewer model, distinct response identity per round, and the memory artifact chain

rounds.stopWhen: score >= 6 and verdict in {ready, almost} or max rounds reached

reframer.when: stuck after critic attribution, before plan_change

roles.purpose: verify every claim maps to an artifact before handoff

4-summary.gate: a claim marked supported needs an evidence path; unresolved claims stay undetermined or failed.

5-writing.gate: Markdown is not a submission PDF; compile and audit before claiming completion.

globalRules: A role may load only the skills listed for its stage; loading a stage-foreign skill requires a recorded reason.
Skills that need shell/Python must not be assigned to roles without bash.
The same skill used by two roles must run in separate contexts; sharing a context defeats the purpose.
No stage may consume another agent's unverified conclusion; cross-stage input is an artifact path plus its gate result.
The research loop records goal, attempts and stuck state; it does not decide which stage runs next.
